title: Asymptotic Condorcet winner bound
statement: Let $f_n$ be a Boolean function on $n$ voters’ pairwise vote vectors, with values in $\\{\pm1\}$. Suppose that for every $n$, all singleton Fourier coefficients of $f_n$ are equal. Then there is a real sequence $r_n=o(1)$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$, the probability that the societal outcome has a Condorcet winner is at most $\frac79+\frac{4}{9\pi}+r_n$, when the voters’ rankings are chosen uniformly and independently from the six rankings of three candidates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f_n$ is given for every natural number $n$.
For each $n$, the singleton Fourier coefficients of $f_n$ are equal.
